Nora (Growth): Quick sync: planning a 25min micro-launch webinar for APAC/EU. Need final run-of-show, speaker order, and lead routing. Goals: practical benchmarks + 1 clear CTA to triage form.
Eli (Events): Proposed structure: 2m intro, 8m demo A, 8m demo B, 5m live Q&A, 2m close = 25m. Require 90s recorded fallback per demo.
Jules (Design): I'll build a compact 6-slide deck and 1-slide fallback prompts. Will also export MP4 clips named demoA_fallback.mp4/demoB_fallback.mp4.
Sam (Eng Ops): Registration fields: deployment_interest (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), monthly_spend_bucket, hidden workload_type. Map to SFDC campaign = microlaunch_apac2026. High-value leads (> $5k) -> immediate Slack ping to #sdr-apac.
Nora (Growth): Add UTM: utm_campaign=microlaunch_apac, utm_medium=webinar. Also one registration question: Which capacity are you evaluating? (Hosted/Dedicated/Private).
Eli (Events): Rehearsals: full dress 48h prior (30m) + tech check 15m prior. CueBot, can you schedule T-48h, T-30m, T-10m, T-2m cues and pin run-of-show?
CueBot: Confirmed. Will post cues and pin drive link at T-30m. Also will post fallback script at T-5m.
Sam (Eng Ops): SLA: high_value -> assign within 12h; others -> 48h. I'll post the Zapier -> SFDC mapping doc in this thread by EOD.
Nora (Growth): Owners: Eli (events/greenroom), Sam (lead routing + SLA), Jules (slides + fallback clips), Nora (moderator + copy). I'll draft registration copy tomorrow. Thanks!
